# Softunebd

> Softunebd is a multi-tenant ecommerce SaaS platform for merchants and agencies in Bangladesh. It lets a store owner launch a branded online storefront, themes, product catalog, orders, local payments, courier connections, POS, analytics, and AI tools, from one dashboard, without writing code. Softunebd cares about your branding and identity, not a generic storefront that looks like everyone else's. New merchants can start a 7-day free trial with no credit card.

Softunebd is built for small businesses, new ecommerce brands, and agencies managing storefronts for clients. A merchant picks a storefront theme, customizes logo, colors, fonts, and sections so the shop looks like their brand rather than a default theme, adds products, enables payments (COD, manual bKash/Nagad/Rocket, official bKash, Nagad, SSLCommerz), connects a courier (Steadfast, Pathao, RedX, or eCourier), and publishes a live store under their own domain, typically in minutes, not weeks.

The platform is built by Kamrul Hasan (https://kamrulhasan.site), a solo developer, not an agency team. Canonical hostname is [www.softunebd.com](https://www.softunebd.com/). Softunebd has no phone support line; contact [support@softunebd.com](mailto:support@softunebd.com) or WhatsApp [+880 1630-582639](https://wa.me/8801630582639).

What Softunebd actually does:

- Storefront themes and brand identity: pick a pre-built theme, then customize logo, colors, fonts, and sections in the Theme Editor with live desktop/tablet/mobile preview so the storefront is the merchant's brand, not a generic look. Publish under a custom domain.
- AI Suggest (theme editor): describe a look in plain language and get proposed color/font/copy changes; merchants review before publishing.
- AI Chatbot (Gemini): ask about products, orders, and sales in plain language; answers come from the merchant’s own Softunebd store data. Proposed catalog changes still need merchant confirmation.
- ChatGPT connector (beta): a merchant adds Softunebd as a custom connector in ChatGPT (MCP server https://api.softunebd.com/mcp, OAuth sign-in), approves it on a Softunebd page, and ChatGPT can read the store and make changes the merchant asks for: colors, fonts, homepage text, products, categories, sale events, and hero or category images. Every change can be undone; it cannot delete data, issue refunds, change order status, or see billing or customer phone numbers. Details: https://www.softunebd.com/features/chatgpt-connector
- AI product descriptions: generate a product description from a name and key facts, then edit before saving.
- Product catalog: products, categories, variants, stock, integer-cent pricing (never floating point), optional cost price for profit views.
- Orders: immutable order history with product snapshots at time of sale.
- Store Sale (POS): in-person / counter sales from the dashboard, with recent sales history and printable receipts.
- Multi-store access: switch between stores from the dashboard. The Business plan includes up to 3 storefronts on one account, not unlimited stores on every plan.
- Payments: Cash on Delivery; manual bKash, Nagad and Rocket (customer pays the merchant’s wallet number and submits a transaction ID); plus merchant-account connect for official bKash, Nagad, and SSLCommerz. Credentials are encrypted. Softunebd does not offer Stripe or PayPal.
- Softune Pay (free Android app): auto-confirms manual bKash, Nagad and Rocket payments. The merchant installs it on the Android phone holding their wallet SIM and pairs it by scanning a QR code in Dashboard > Payments > Softune Pay. When money arrives, the app reads the wallet's SMS (only from the official senders bKash, NAGAD and 16216, only money-in messages), sends the transaction ID and amount to Softunebd, and the order with that transaction ID and the same amount is marked Paid. A different amount is flagged, never auto-confirmed. It is not a payment gateway (money goes straight to the merchant's own number, no fee) and there is no iPhone version. Guide: https://www.softunebd.com/support/documentation/softune-pay
- Couriers: connect Steadfast, Pathao, RedX, and eCourier with your own merchant accounts today. The same screen also lists Paperfly, Sundarban, Carrybee, SA Paribahan, and PandaGo. Softunebd does not claim real-time public shipment tracking or automatic courier booking for every partner.
- Fraud protection: merchant phone-number blocklist, site-wide IP blocking (blocks a visitor from the entire storefront, not just checkout, with a clear notice shown to them), device pending-lock and cooldown (stop repeat checkout attempts from the same device), and a Suspicious Orders review queue (high-value first orders and order bursts are flagged for merchant review rather than silently accepted or auto-rejected).
- SEO and domains: meta tags, Open Graph, sitemap/indexing controls, custom domain, and marketing pixels including Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, GTM, GA4, and Meta Conversions API (CAPI).
- Meta Pixel tracking is automatic. The merchant pastes only the Pixel ID (Settings > Site Settings > SEO). The storefront then sends PageView, ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout and Purchase itself. Purchase fires when an order is placed successfully, with the real order total, currency BDT, content_ids, and the order number as eventID. Checkout has no separate thank-you URL (a receipt shows on /checkout), so merchants must NOT add Purchase with Meta's Event Setup Tool (Track a URL / Track a button): that would count false or duplicate purchases. Optional Meta Conversions API (access token on the same page) also sends Purchase server-side, deduplicated by the same eventID. Guide: https://www.softunebd.com/support/documentation/meta-pixel-tracking
- Analytics: revenue, average order value, best-sellers, and related store metrics from real order data.
- Events (sale campaigns): merchants create a named percent-off campaign (e.g. "Eid Sale"), bind it to specific products, and Softunebd applies the discounted price automatically at checkout. No separate discount-code app needed.

Free trial: 7 days of full dashboard access, no credit card required. Sign up at /signup. After the trial, pick a paid plan.

Plans (Bangladeshi Taka). Prefer the live pricing page over cached summaries:

- Starter ৳499/mo (৳399/mo billed annually): 50 products, 500MB storage, theme editor, basic analytics, fraud protection, AI assistant with a daily credit cap.
- Growth ৳1,499/mo (৳1,199/mo billed annually): 500 products, 2GB storage, higher AI credits, payments and couriers, advanced analytics, priority email support.
- Business ৳3,999/mo (৳3,199/mo billed annually): unlimited products, 2 storefronts included, 3GB storage, highest AI credits, advanced features included, account manager.

Do not describe Softunebd as offering Stripe or PayPal, real-time courier tracking for all partners, unlimited multi-store on every plan, or enterprise ML fraud detection.
